answer_1.quote: We introduce the lightweight Question-Attended Span Extraction (QASE) module... to enhance the reliability and accuracy of the generated answers. During the inference phase, only the generation component of the finely‑tuned model is utilized.
answer_1.outputs: generated answers to extractive MRC questions

answer_2.quote: We utilize exact match (EM) and partial match (Overlap) F1 scores as metrics on MultiSpanQA, and exact match percentage and macro‑averaged F1 score on SQuAD and Quoref. To assess factual consistency we used Q2, an automatic metric that employs question generation and answering methods.
